ns2:section.sectionText: The course will focus on the ever growing area of social media marketing. Topics of the course will range from omni-channel marketing, to digital maturity of firms, to social media plan development, to social media segmentation, targeting, and positioning. The course will be giving students a hands-on approach to social media marketing with social media analytics, content creation, and interactive discussion. Please be aware this course will be cancelled if a 20 student minimum enrollment is not met. Please find information about the online course here: http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/.
